title: Wanted: The Escape of Carlos Ghosn

1.name: Chapter 1: Hubris
1.ov: An ambitious plan leads to unimaginable success when Carlos Ghosn takes control of Renault and Nissan. As his star rises, cracks surface.

1.name: Chapter 2: Hostage Justice
1.ov: Ghosn feels the grip of the Japanese legal system, allies shed light on a possible conspiracy, and enemies wage a bigger war.

1.name: Chapter 3: Escape
1.ov: Arrested again, Ghosn turns to a high-stakes scheme—complete with a pulse-pounding disappearing act.

1.name: Chapter 4: Victim or Villain?
1.ov: Secrets from Ghosn’s past emerge, while his decision to flee has a seismic impact.
